title: Passage 49
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: When cold weather comes, many birds move to the south.
sentences.cn: 寒冷天气来临时，许多鸟类会向南方迁徙。

sentences.en: Many animals do not remain in one place.
sentences.cn: 许多动物不会固定停留在一个地方。

sentences.en: Moving is a normal part of their lives.
sentences.cn: 迁徙是它们生活中很正常的一部分。

sentences.en: Some move to find food more easily,
sentences.cn: 有些动物迁移是为了更容易找到食物，

sentences.en: but others move to get away from crowded places or to survive disasters like an earthquake.
sentences.cn: 而有些则是为了远离拥挤的地方，或者在地震等灾难中存活下来。

sentences.en: We can compare this action to people moving for better opportunities.
sentences.cn: 我们可以将这种行为与人类为了更好机会而迁移相比较。

sentences.en: Some fishes give birth in warm water and move to cold water to feed.
sentences.cn: 有些鱼类在温暖的水域产卵，然后游到冷水域觅食。

sentences.en: The most famous migration is probably that of the fish called salmon.
sentences.cn: 其中最著名的迁徙可能是一种叫“鲑鱼”的鱼类。

sentences.en: This fish is usually grey, but turns red when it is ready to breed.
sentences.cn: 这种鱼通常是灰色的，但在准备交配繁殖时会变成红色。

sentences.en: It is born in fresh water but travels miles to salt water.
sentences.cn: 它们出生在淡水中，却要跋涉数英里来到海水中。

sentences.en: They must fight against the strong force of the river and avoid being hunted by bears,
sentences.cn: 它们必须对抗河流的强大力量，还要躲避熊的捕食，

sentences.en: because the law of nature allows only the strongest salmon to survive.
sentences.cn: 因为自然法则只允许最强壮的鲑鱼存活下来。

sentences.en: When it is old, it returns to its birthplace in fresh water.
sentences.cn: 当它们年老时，会回到淡水的出生地。

sentences.en: Then it gives birth and dies.
sentences.cn: 然后它们产卵并死去。

sentences.en: In the north of Europe, there is a kind of mouse.
sentences.cn: 在欧洲北部有一种老鼠。

sentences.en: They usually look pale, but when their homes become crowded, their colour gets brighter.
sentences.cn: 它们通常毛色较淡，但当它们的栖息地变得拥挤时，其毛色就会变得更鲜艳。

sentences.en: They have a crazy way of moving.
sentences.cn: 它们的迁徙方式有些疯狂。

sentences.en: Sometimes they move all the way to the seaside, forming large groups like an army.
sentences.cn: 有时，它们会一路迁徙到海边，成群结队地前进，就像军队一样。

sentences.en: Many of them are killed when they fall into the sea.
sentences.cn: 它们中有许多会掉入海里丧生。

sentences.en: Recently, scientists have studied a special kind of lobsters.
sentences.cn: 最近，科学家研究了一种特殊的龙虾。

sentences.en: Every year, when the season of bad weather arrives,
sentences.cn: 每年，当天气恶劣的季节来临时，

sentences.en: the lobsters get into a long line and start to walk across the floor of the ocean, just like soldiers marching.
sentences.cn: 这些龙虾就排成长队，开始在海底行走，就像士兵行军一样。

sentences.en: Nobody knows where they go.
sentences.cn: 没有人知道它们要去哪里。

sentences.en: The reason why animals move may vary.
sentences.cn: 动物迁徙的原因可能各不相同。

sentences.en: Maybe living things just like to travel.
sentences.cn: 也许生物就是喜欢“旅行”。
